description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Rammus''' enters a defensive stance for 7 seconds, gaining [[File:Armor icon.svg|15px|link=Armor]] '''bonus''' armor and [[File:Magic resistance icon.svg|15px|link=Magic resistance]] '''bonus''' magic resistance. While active, enemies that use a basic attack [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] against '''Rammus''' are dealt 15 (+ 10% '''total''' armor) (+ 10% '''total''' magic resistance) magic damage.
description.text: Active: Rammus enters a defensive stance for 7 seconds, gaining  bonus armor and  bonus magic resistance. While active, enemies that use a basic attack on-hit against Rammus are dealt 15 (+ 10% total armor) (+ 10% total magic resistance) magic damage.

description2.raw: ''Defensive Ball Curl'' can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically upon casting ''[[File:Rammus Powerball.png|20xpx|border|link=Rammus#Powerball|An icon for Rammus's ability Powerball]] [[Rammus#Powerball|Powerball]]'' or ''[[File:Rammus Soaring Slam.png|20xpx|border|link=Rammus#Soaring Slam|An icon for Rammus's ability Soaring Slam]] [[Rammus#Soaring Slam|Soaring Slam]]''.
description2.text: Defensive Ball Curl can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically upon casting Powerball or Soaring Slam.

description3.text: Recast: Rammus ends Defensive Ball Curl.

notes.raw: *The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. **Deactivating the ability manually does not. * ''Defensive Ball Curl'' ends immediately if [[File:Rammus Powerball.png|20xpx|border|link=Rammus#Powerball|An icon for Rammus's ability Powerball]] [[Rammus#Powerball|Powerball]] is cast. * ''Defensive Ball Curl'' will return damage from attacks and/or abilities that apply [[on-hit effect]]s ([[File:Ezreal Mystic Shot.png|20xpx|border|link=Ezreal#Mystic Shot|An icon for Ezreal's ability Mystic Shot]] [[Ezreal#Mystic Shot|Mystic Shot]]) as well as from [[File:Runaan's Hurricane item.png|20xpx|border|link=Runaan's Hurricane|An icon for the item Runaan's Hurricane]] [[Runaan's Hurricane|Runaan's Hurricane's]] [[Named item effect#Wind's Fury|Wind's Fury]] (will not return damage from [[turret]]s, [[File:Heimerdinger H-28G Evolution Turret.png|20xpx|border|link=Heimerdinger#H-28G Evolution Turret|An icon for Heimerdinger's ability H-28G Evolution Turret]] [[Heimerdinger#H-28G Evolution Turret|H-28G Evolution Turret]], or [[File:Shaco Jack in the Box.png|20xpx|border|link=Shaco#Jack in the Box|An icon for Shaco's ability Jack in the Box]] [[Shaco#Jack in the Box|Jack in the Box]]). * The resistance scaling will factor from all sources, including ''Defensive Ball Curl's'' flat bonus. This will recalculate over the duration.
notes.text:
The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
*Deactivating the ability manually does not.
Defensive Ball Curl ends immediately if Powerball is cast.
Defensive Ball Curl will return damage from attacks and/or abilities that apply on-hit effects ( Mystic Shot) as well as from Runaan's Hurricane's Wind's Fury (will not return damage from turrets, H-28G Evolution Turret, or Jack in the Box).
The resistance scaling will factor from all sources, including Defensive Ball Curl's flat bonus. This will recalculate over the duration.
